events.note: 美股及股票期权全天休市；下次常规开盘为 2026-09-08 09:30（美东时间）。
events.note_en: US stocks and equity options are closed all day. Next regular open: 2026-09-08 at 09:30 ET.

impacts.title: 短期期权：时间仍在流逝
impacts.body: 买入 Call 或 Put 后，即使休市，合约也在接近到期，时间价值仍可能减少（Theta）。越接近到期越要留意；假期影响可能已提前反映在报价中，不能直接按「一天 Theta × 休市天数」算实际亏损。
impacts.body_en: Long calls and puts move closer to expiry while markets are closed, so time value can erode (Theta), especially near expiry. Quotes can reflect the holiday in advance; daily Theta multiplied by days closed is not a reliable measure of the actual loss.

impacts.title: 无法交易调整，复市可能跳空
impacts.title_en: No exchange trading; reopening prices can gap
impacts.body: 美股及股票期权休市期间不能在这些交易所平仓。假期消息可能让复市价格跳离前收盘；卖出期权也仍有价格跳空和指派风险。
impacts.body_en: You cannot close stock or equity-option positions on these exchanges during the closure. Holiday news can move reopening prices away from the prior close. Short options still carry gap and assignment risk.

impacts.title: 核对到期和行权截止时间
impacts.body: 不同合约的最后交易日、结算和券商行权截止时间可能不同。看具体合约通知；期货、部分指数期权和其他市场不一定一起休市。
impacts.body_en: Last trading dates, settlement and broker exercise deadlines vary by contract. Check the contract notice; futures, some index options and other markets can follow different schedules.

events.title_en: US markets close early · Day after Thanksgiving

events.note_en: Regular stock trading ends at 13:00 ET; eligible options close at 13:15 ET.

impacts.title: 交易时间缩短
impacts.body: 处理到期合约、调整仓位和行权的时间更短；节日前后成交可能变少，买卖价差可能扩大。券商截止时间及盘后时段按具体市场核对。
impacts.body_en: There is less time to adjust positions or manage expiring contracts. Holiday trading can be thinner, with wider spreads. Check broker deadlines and each venue’s extended-hours schedule.
